verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing says teams can share one business number and stay aligned, and its docs refer to Quo inboxes tied to numbers. That supports texts to a shared business number landing in a team-accessible inbox. Nothing shows team members can see which colleague replied to a conversation. Missing for 10: documentation that inbound texts land in a shared team inbox view, per-reply sender attribution showing who replied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic, or list all your inboxes to see which numbers are available.
Set up a business number in minutes
